title: Kaha Sakina ne Zainab se
body:
Kaha Sakina(sa) ne Zainab(as) se ye batao phuppi -2
Hamare khaimay logon ne kyun jalaye hain - (2)
1) Bataaon gi mere chacha ko zara anay do - 2
Ae shimr tu ne - 2
tamachay mujhe lagaye hain
2) Khata thi kya meray baba ki kya tha jurm kya - 2
Ye teer baba pe -2
ummat ne kyun chalaye hain
3) Thay teer itnay badan mein Sakina(sa) mil na saki - 2
Hussain(as) seenay pe - 2
Beti sula na paye hain
4) Chiraag deene Muhammad(saww)  ka bhuja dete ye log -2
Diye wo khoon se -2 Shabbir(as) ne jalaye hain
Yaseen Mirza
